en-GB.name: Radio Freccia Nera Classical
en-GB.summary: Listen to Radio Freccia Nera Classical live on Alexa.
en-GB.description: Listen to Radio Freccia Nera Classical live on Alexa. The station opens directly from the skill. To listen, say: Alexa, open Black Arrow Classical.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Black Arrow Classical to start the radio.
Alexa, ask Black Arrow Classical to play the radio.
